provider: Registro de Información Catastral de Guatemala (RIC) Geoportal and official GeoServer WFS; Municipalidad de Quetzaltenango catastro department reviewed separately
scope: The official RIC national cadastral service was traced from the live viewer JavaScript and queried anonymously. Exact-point and bounded Quetzaltenango requests returned zero features; this is a map/query result, not evidence of citywide absence.
schemaAndCrs: GEO_RIC:PREDIO, Polygon field geometria, advertised viewer CRS EPSG:90180; GeoJSON supports EPSG:4326. Schema fields observed were ccc, fase, area, perimetro, id_departamento, cod_municipio, and geometria.
nativeIdentity: ccc is the source-native cadastral classification code exposed by the schema. No city-specific feature was returned, so no identity was retained.

requestOutcome: All official viewer, capabilities, schema, and municipal page requests loaded. An unbounded one-feature request returned one polygon elsewhere in Guatemala, confirming public geometry is technically available.
